verdict.rationale: An internal API catalog or portal is a fair question for an API development platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only adjacent features: team collections for organizing requests and a single-request HTML embed. Nothing documents a publishable catalog or portal where teams discover and consume APIs, and a community user notes you 'can't create documentation for a folder/request.'

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can publish an internal catalog or portal where teams discover and consume our APIs
